mainEntity.name: Does DROS integrate with our loan servicing platform?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. DROS syncs delinquent accounts via CSV or API - balances, DPD bucket, contact info, and payment history. There is no migration project and nothing changes in your system of record. Most lenders are live within days.

mainEntity.name: How does DROS decide the strategy for each bucket?

acceptedAnswer.text: Each DPD bucket runs its own cadence, tone, and offer within rules you approve - friendly reminders early, escalated negotiation through the Promise-to-Pay Engine mid-cycle, and human handoff with full context once judgment is required.

mainEntity.name: Will borrowers know they are talking to AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: DROS agents identify themselves per your disclosure requirements. Conversations are natural, patient, and scripted to your standards - borrowers can always request a person, and those conversations route to your team instantly with full context.

mainEntity.name: How does DROS handle Reg F, FDCPA, and state mini-FDCPA rules for first-party lending?

acceptedAnswer.text: Contact frequency, timing, and disclosure rules are enforced at the system level before any attempt is made - including state-specific mini-FDCPA requirements. Every interaction is recorded, transcribed, and exportable on demand.
Plans start at a flat monthly rate with included call minutes - no per-seat pricing, no long implementation fees. See pricing, or talk to us about your portfolio size.
